$doc: Campaign controller — the single spec sheet ops edits to retune the program. The engine and frontend both read this file. Env vars still hold the SECURITY gates (MEGAPOT_ACTIVE, MEGAPOT_WHITELIST, keys) — this file holds the PRODUCT parameters.

campaign.name: MegaHence Rewards - Season 1
campaign.$tierSinceMs: multiplier tiers count Hence AI basket volume from the ORIGINAL season start (2026-08-24 11:59 UTC) so pre-launch baskets keep their tier; startMs still governs which fills earn credit. Hub mirrors it.
campaign.$note: Season 1 LIVE window: Sep 2 2026 20:00 UTC through Sep 16 2026 22:00 UTC (14 days). start/end are hard bounds - fills outside the window never credit. Deploy dispatch start_ms/end_ms must match (env overrides this sheet).

eligibility.$products: product suites this campaign covers: perps (native HL coins) | xyz-equities (coins prefixed xyz:) | spot (Robinhood Chain swaps via the hence backend's relay-spot feed — SPOT_FILLS_URL; fills carry Hence's 25bps app fee as builderFee and credit that EXACT fee, not a bps-of-notional recompute, because our own receipts ledger records it per fill) | baskets (fills recorded via thesis executions — needs app stitch) | predictions (not yet supported)
eligibility.$symbols: empty = ALL symbols on the enabled products qualify (Season 1 rule: every product on Hence). Add tickers to restrict.
eligibility.$excludeZeroFeePairs: symbols currently running zero-fee promos (no fee revenue → no credit), e.g. the xyz rebate campaign list

economics.$note: 4.0bps = Hence's LIVE builder-fee take (verified /api/config hlBuilderFee=40 tenths). Charged on routed orders regardless of maker/taker, so accrual is identical on maker flow. Ticket conversion always uses Megapot's live ticketPrice().
economics.$spotNote: Relay-spot fills credit their EXACT recorded fee (builderFee on the feed row = the 25bps app fee our own ledger stored for that swap) times rolloverShare — no spotFeeBps knob exists on purpose: a bps recompute could drift from what was actually charged, and unlike HL (where the engine reads the venue's feed) the spot fee is first-party ground truth.

multipliers.requires: Base rate - every qualifying trade counts.
$1,000+ of thesis basket volume this season.
$2,500+ of thesis basket volume this season.
$5,000+ of thesis basket volume this season.
$10,000+ of thesis basket volume this season.

caps.$globalBudgetUsdc: SEASON 1 BUDGET (Sarthak, 2026-09-02): 820+ tickets seeded into the pool wallet = 200 activation packs (FCFS) + 420 streak boxes (30/day x 14) + 200 multiplier rebate cap; trading-fee rebate is UNCAPPED and topped up daily. This ceiling is a spend safety stop, not the budget: keep it above wallet balance and raise it with each top-up (deploy dispatch budget_usdc overrides; LIVE dispatch 2026-09-03: budget_usdc=1500). Retro: Megapot sends 12 tickets/day to the pool wallet (168 over the season) as NFTs, not USDC - they are handed out by the retro transfer path (see `retro`) and do not count against this USDC ceiling.
caps.$retroTickets: Megapot's 12 tickets/day land in the pool wallet as TicketNFTs (inventory, not USDC). With retro.enabled the engine transfers pool-held tickets of the ACTIVE round to users to settle credit BEFORE buying with USDC (RETRO_TRANSFERS=1, TICKET_NFT in the deploy env). Tickets from a closed round cannot be handed out and stay in stock. See `retro` below.

firstTradeBonus.$note: activation pack: account + email + first qualifying trade >= minTradeUsd ($100) opens a pack of 1-5 tickets DRAWN AT RANDOM from a fixed season pool - 150 pack slots totalling exactly 200 tickets, drawn without replacement (odds at launch: 76.0% / 17.3% / 4.7% / 1.3% / 0.7%). The draw depletes s.packSlots in the ledger, so odds drift as slots fill and the pool can never overshoot. dailyMintCap still paces minting per UTC day. QUALIFICATION: one fill >= minTradeUsd ($100) OR combined in-window volume >= minTradeUsd ($100).

terms.title: MegaHence Rewards · Season 1 rules
steps: Season 1 runs from September 2, 2026 (20:00 UTC) to September 16, 2026 (22:00 UTC). Trades outside the window do not count.
Sign in to Hence with your wallet. Linking an email is optional, but it is where draw results and win alerts go.
Your first trade of $100 or more (one trade, or $100 combined) opens your activation pack: 1 to 5 free tickets drawn from the 200-ticket season pool. Scratch to reveal.
Every trade after that earns credit: 0.04% of your qualifying volume on any Hence market, maker or taker. $1 of credit = 1 ticket. No limit.
Trade $250 or more in a day and you open that day's surprise box. Day 2 hits 60% of the time; later boxes hit less often but hold more, up to 8 tickets on day 14.
Thesis-basket volume unlocks 2x to 5x tiers: +25% to +100% extra credit on everything you trade. Tiers switch on when basket tracking goes live.
Tickets mint to your own wallet within about 5 minutes of crossing $1 of credit. Megapot draws every day. Match numbers to win.

actions.reward: Activation pack: 1 to 5 tickets (200-ticket pool, first come first served)
Surprise box: day 2 pays 60% of the time (+1). Days 5 to 14 pay less often but 2 to 8 tickets.
The big boxes: 4, 5, 6 and 8 tickets on days 11 to 14

caps: Per wallet: up to 5 tickets mint per day and 15 per rolling week. Anything above that queues and mints at the same pace. Nothing earned is lost.
Across all users: at most 30 activation-pack tickets and 30 surprise-box tickets mint per UTC day. Later grants mint the next day.
Season pools: 200 activation-pack tickets, 420 surprise-box tickets, 200 multiplier tickets. The trading rebate itself is uncapped.
All daily caps reset at 00:00 UTC.
disclosures: Tickets are entries in Megapot's daily draw. Winning is chance-based and no prize is guaranteed. Prizes, odds, draw mechanics and claims are operated by Megapot under Megapot's terms.
Tickets mint non-custodially to your own wallet on Base. Hence never holds your tickets or winnings.
Reward credit has no cash value and converts only to tickets at Megapot's live ticket price (about $1) at mint time.

Activation packs are drawn without replacement from 150 pack slots totalling 200 tickets: 1 ticket (76.0%), 2 (17.3%), 3 (4.7%), 4 (1.3%), 5 (0.7%). Odds drift as slots fill. Every qualifying activation gets at least 1 ticket while the pool lasts.

Surprise-box odds by trade day: day 1 15%, day 2 60%, day 3 45%, day 4 35%, then 30% falling to 12% by day 14, with box sizes rising from 1 to 8 tickets. A trade day counts once $250 of qualifying volume is reached.
Zero-fee promotional pairs are excluded from earning while their promotion is active.
Email is optional. Draw results and win alerts go to your linked email. Marketing consent is recorded either way; you can decline and still take part fully.
Multiplier tiers (2x to 5x) activate when basket tracking goes live this season. Until then the base rate applies, and tier rungs may be retuned.
Not available where Megapot's terms prohibit participation, including the United States and the United Kingdom. Parameters may be retuned between seasons.

assetTable.note: Volume shown mints ONE ticket at the base 1x tier (0.04% of volume at the $1 live ticket price). Maker or taker earn the same. Every product on Hence qualifies. Higher tiers cut the volume needed by their factor.

$multipliers: DECIDED 2026-09-03: tiers are KICKERS on top of base minting - 2x = +25% credit on qualifying volume, 3x = +50%, 4x = +75%, 5x = +100% (200% of fees back). Tiers unlock on thesis-basket VOLUME (entry $1,000 per the rules doc). The $2,500/$5,000/$10,000 rungs for 3x-5x are proposed defaults pending final sign-off. Tiers activate when basket tracking goes live; base rate applies until then.

streakBox.$note: DAILY SURPRISE BOX (replaces the day-3/day-5 checkpoints while enabled): every distinct qualifying trade day since campaign start rolls one box against engine/src/streakBox.js STREAK_BOX_MATRIX - day 2 hits 60% (x1), hit-rate falls every day after, box size rises to 4-8 tickets past day 10. EV: 5-day trader ~2.2, 10-day ~4.7, 14-day ~7.8 tickets. Grants come from this shared season pool and flow through the same streakTicketsPending credit + daily caps.
streakBox.$minDayUsd: a trade day only opens a box once the day's qualifying volume reaches this - a $1 trade must not roll a 60% box
streakBox.$dailyCap: season-wide: at most this many streak-box tickets credit per UTC day (FCFS by cycle order); the rest wait on the wallet and credit the next day - nothing earned is lost

$requireBuilderFee: Only fills that carried Hence's builder fee count for credit, packs and streak boxes. Direct HL trades earn nothing (they earn Hence nothing).

multiplierBonus.$note: the EXTRA tickets multiplier tiers produce (above base fee rebate) are capped season-wide at 200. Kicker enforcement and this cap are BUILT in the engine (engine.js applies the tier kicker and MULT_BONUS_POOL); they activate when BASKET_URL is set in the deploy env (tier feed). Until then the base rate applies.

testReset.$note: Team-test reset (2026-09-03): node src/run.js reset <wallets> wipes those wallets' ledger state and returns their pool draws. The hub clears its per-wallet markers when resetEpoch changes.

hub.$note: hub-only keys merged to the top level of neo-hence web/src/lib/megapot-campaign.ts by engine/scripts/gen-hub-sheet.mjs. marketingConsentDefault=false: the consent box is unticked by default (pre-ticked consent fails EU rules, Planet49). engineCycleS mirrors ENGINE_INTERVAL_S (300): buys land within one cycle of a threshold crossing.

retro.$note: Megapot mints 12 tickets/day to the pool wallet; the engine transfers pool-held tickets of the ACTIVE round to users before buying with USDC
